Undal ran into a problem while it was starting, and it has stopped trying to reopen itself so it does not keep flashing at you.\n\nYour orders, your basket and your account are all on the server — nothing was lost by this. Try again below; if it fails a second time, send the report to the kitchen and order by phone while it is being fixed.

If you copy the report, send it to the kitchen on WhatsApp or by phone. It names the part of Undal that failed, the version it failed on and the phone it failed on, which is what turns a two-day investigation into a two-minute one.
